build_lvis_dataset: build an LVIS detection dataset for train or val splits using the build function
create_lvis_annotation_index: create an LVIS annotation index by loading a JSON annotation file with the LVIS class
get_lvis_annotation_ids: get LVIS annotation IDs filtered by image IDs, category IDs, or area range
convert_lvis_ann_to_mask: convert an LVIS annotation object to a binary mask using ann_to_mask
create_lvis_transforms: create LVIS training or validation image transforms with random resize, crop, and normalization
